text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a breast mass; can you tell me how long you have noticed it and if it has changed in size or shape?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: I have already gathered sufficient information from your history regarding the rapid growth of the left breast mass over four weeks.
